artists.source_line: From May 1st to 9th, 2027, Karibean Trip Kiz takes you to Bali for a new experience blending travel, discovery, escapism, and dance.

features.rationale: The 'THE TRIP INCLUDES' list names accommodation as part of the package.
Breakfast is listed under 'THE TRIP INCLUDES', so meals are part of the package.
Transfers are listed as included in the trip, which means shuttles or transport.
